item.title: Flyers win third in a row with 3-2 shootout decision over struggling Maple Leafs
item.description: TORONTO — Matvei Michkov and Trevor Zegras scored in a shootout and the visiting Philadelphia Flyers beat the Toronto Maple Leafs 3-2, extending the hosts' losing streak to four games on Monday.

item.title: Want to see Tuesday's 'blood moon' lunar eclipse? Plan to get up early
item.description: Those in the west — like B.C. — have a better chance of seeing Tuesday's full totality, which will begin at 3:04 a.m. Pacific time.

item.title: Stars extend win streak to franchise-high nine games with 6-1 victory over Canucks
item.description: VANCOUVER — Two goals from Lian Bichsel powered the Dallas Stars to a lopsided 6-1 victory over the struggling Vancouver Canucks on Monday.

item.title: Marchenko scores 2nd goal in OT as Blue Jackets beat Rangers 5-4
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — Kirill Marchenko scored his second goal of the game 1:04 into overtime and the Columbus Blue Jackets edged the New York Rangers 5-4 Monday night after squandering a four-goal lead.

item.title: Royals shoot down Winterhawks on Pink in the Rink Night
item.description: The Victoria Royals visit Kamloops on Friday night before heading to Kelowna and Seattle.

item.title: Design approved for pedestrian, cyclist pathway on Mt. Newton Cross Road
item.description: It features a two-metre-wide grass separation for about one kilometre before a narrower separation via a painted line for 300 metres.

item.title: B.C.'s premier is celebrating the move to permanent daylight time. Others aren't so sure
item.description: Critics of the change argue that it’s not in sync with the Pacific states in the U.S., it’s bad for sleep patterns, and it will be more dangerous for kids walking and riding their bikes to school and pedestrians crossing roads in the dark.
